about.title: About
about.text: For me, web development is the perfect intersection of logical architecture and tangible user value. With a strong IT background, my focus goes beyond just making things work: I build clean, modular, and maintainable applications—from reliable backend logic to responsive, intuitive UI design. My drive comes from solving complex technical challenges and turning robust ideas into performant digital solutions.
about.cta: Let's connect and create something amazing together!

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Through various projects, I have gained hands-on experience building dynamic web applications with modern HTML, CSS/SCSS, and JavaScript, leveraging frameworks like Angular. Given how quickly web development evolves, I continuously expand my skill set—focusing on clean, scalable code and keeping up with modern standards and best practices.
skills.subtext: Technologies never stand still, and neither do I. If your stack requires a specific tool or a new framework, I am always enthusiastic and quick to dive in and master it.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.description: Explore a selection of my work here - Interact with projects to see my skills in action.

projects.pollo-loco: Jump, run and throw game based on object-orientated approach. Help Pepe to find coins and tabasco salsa to fight against the crazy hen.
projects.join: Task manager inspired by the Kanban System. Create and organize tasks using drag and drop functions, assign users and categories.
projects.pokedex: Based on the PokéAPI a simple library that provides and catalogues pokemon information.

references.schuster: Michael really kept the team together with his great organization and clear communication. We wouldn't have got this far without his commitment.
references.eichinger: Michi was a top team colleague at DA. His positive commitment and willingness to take on responsibility made a significant contribution to us achieving our goals.
references.nuber: It was a great pleasure to work with Michael. He knows how to push and encourage team members to present the best work possible, always adding something to brainstorm. Regarding the well-being of group members, he was always present and available to listen and help others, with a great sense of humor as well.

contact.title: Contact

contact.description: I help turn ideas into clean, performant, and intuitive web applications. Whether you're looking to strengthen your frontend team or need a reliable developer to bring your digital project to life—let's connect and discuss how I can contribute.
